name: Character IP-Adapter dual reference (face + body)
description: Feeds TWO confirmed design references into one IP-Adapter via ImageBatch: the decided front face and the T-pose body base. Use this for full-body design sheets, where the face reference alone biases the composition toward a portrait and the T-pose reference alone cannot drive ControlNet (its head is cropped off). combine_embeds is 'concat', sampler dpmpp_2m/karras. SD1.5 only: ckpt 'dreamshaper_8.safetensors' for the semi-realistic 3D-render look, 'Counterfeit-V3.0_fix_fp16.safetensors' for anime. Required overrides: prompt, ckpt, face_ref, body_ref, ip_weight, filename_prefix (plus negative_prompt in practice - if omitted it falls back to the weak global default 'text, watermark').

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, bad anatomy, bad hands, missing limbs, extra limbs, cropped, text, watermark, signature, jpeg artifacts, blurry
